Name: Schedule Sales Order
Field1Value: Order intake, scheduling, and validation workflow. Begins when a client order arrives through any sales channel and ends when the order is confirmed and queued for fulfilment.
Field2Value: Receive client order · Validate cylinder type and quantity · Schedule delivery or pickup · Assign reference number

Name: Fulfil Sales Order
Field1Value: Order execution and physical delivery to the client. Covers warehouse picking, driver dispatch, on-site delivery or pickup, and client signature collection.
Field2Value: Generate Picklist · Pick cylinders · Dispatch Driver and Pahinante · Deliver/pickup · Collect signed DR · Return empty cylinders

Name: Invoicing
Field1Value: Billing and invoice issuance process. Covers generation of the Invoice document, pairing with the Delivery Receipt and Sales Order, and submission to Accounting for reconciliation.
Field2Value: Generate Invoice · Attach to DR and Sales Order · Submit to Accounting · Record in General Ledger

Name: Commercial Gains
Field1Value: Commercial sector commission and profit computation. Gathers weigh-in and weigh-out records at both the client site and plant, then records and distributes commissions.
Field2Value: Gather weight records · Record in Gsheet and ACPAC · Compute commission · Distribute commission

Name: Operational Gains
Field1Value: Operational commission tracking and distribution for dealer channel orders. Includes cylinder weight reconciliation and sales commission calculations.
Field2Value: Track delivery weights · Calculate per-kg commissions · Distribute to Sales Rep

Name: Compute Gains
Field1Value: General commission and gains computation covering all sales channels. Used as a summary step for reconciling total gains per delivery cycle. Distribution.
Field2Value: Aggregate delivery records · Apply commission formula · Generate gains summary

Name: Stock Transfer
Field1Value: Gas content refilling from the Storage Tank to individual cylinders following the FIFO (First-In-First-Out) process. Managed by Plant Staff using the gauge measurement system.
Field2Value: Measure tank volume · Refill cylinders FIFO · Document fill quantities · Update inventory records

Name: FIFO
Field1Value: First-In-First-Out inventory management protocol applied during cylinder refilling. Ensures oldest gas stock is used first to maintain quality and accurate costing.
Field2Value: Identify oldest stock (Tank 1 vs Tank 2) · Refill in FIFO order · Track residue type (Regular vs WIWO)

Name: Pull-out Calendar
Field1Value: Scheduled cylinder retrieval dates at client sites. Coordinates the pull-out of empty or overdue cylinders based on an agreed calendar to maintain cylinder inventory balance.
Field2Value: Set pull-out schedule with client · Assign Driver and Pahinante · Retrieve and weigh cylinders · Update inventory

Name: Sales Reports
Field1Value: Bi-weekly or monthly Sales Performance Report (SPR) generation. IT Head prints the report based on inventory volume; covers sales per kg, total sales, net sales, cost of sales, and Gross Profit Margin.
Field2Value: IT Head prints SPR · Review sales per kg and total sales · Compute net sales and GPM · Distribute to management

Name: Discuss Pricing Matrix
Field1Value: LPG price-setting process using the MGC LPG Pricing Matrix dashboard. Held 1–3 times per month in a General Meeting; covers Sales Price, MPL, Total Cost (Acq Cost + Hauling), and kg per avenue.
Field2Value: General Meeting · Review acquisition and hauling costs · Set price per avenue · Update Pricing Matrix dashboard

Name: Price Cascade Process
Field1Value: Pricing change communication and rollout to all relevant contacts and channels. Mel emails the updates; Jabert logs audit records; each staff member cascades to their assigned client/channel.

Name: End-User Pricing
Field1Value: SRP and competitor pricing comparison process. Mel and Jabert regularly update competitor prices; the result informs End-User SRP decisions in the Pricing Matrix dashboard.
Field2Value: Mel and Jabert gather competitor prices · Update comparison dashboard · Feed into Pricing Matrix meeting

Name: Accounts Receivable
Field1Value: Collection and reconciliation of outstanding client invoices. Includes reviewing monthly summary tables, printing Aged Receivables, bank reconciliation, and resolving customer disputes.
Field2Value: Collect DR + Sales Order + Invoice · Check monthly invoice summary · Print Aged Receivables · Bank reconciliation · Resolve disputes

Name: Financial Statements
Field1Value: Monthly reporting cycle for Profit & Loss Statement, Cash Flow Statement, and Balance Sheet. Each requires all prior entries to be encoded, then tables refreshed and statements printed.
Field2Value: Profit & Loss (PNL) · Cash Flow · Balance Sheet — all refreshed and printed monthly

Name: Payroll
Field1Value: Bi-monthly (15th and 30th) payroll and incentive computation. Uses the Incentive template and LUT forms to balance empty and field cylinder data for Commercial and Retail channels.
Field2Value: Prepare Incentive template · Apply LUT forms · Validate cylinder counts · Encode in payroll system · Release on 15th & 30th

Name: Industrial Projects
Field1Value: Industrial project budget vs. actual PNL and timeline tracking. Produces Budget PNL, Actual PNL, and timeline documents for each industrial engagement.
Field2Value: Budget PNL · Actual PNL · Timeline document

Name: Bank Reconciliation
Field1Value: Matching bank statement records with internal general ledger amounts. Part of the Accounts Receivable workflow; resolved discrepancies are flagged as customer disputes or write-offs.
Field2Value: Print bank summary · Match against GL · Identify variances · Resolve disputes or write-off
